summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the rich repo, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and a (ControlType, str) member to ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the ESC ] 0 ; title BEL formatting entry and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title), guarded by is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200; tests added in tests/test_control.py, tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Tests were not run and Black was not run; the line-length check only flagged pre-existing long docstring lines. Changes are uncommitted in the working tree.
